notes:
Account snapshot: CloudScribe builds a B2B writing-assist platform used by EU legal teams and marketing teams. Mid-market (250 engineers + product). They want a low-friction path to shipping features — start w/ Hosted API to iterate on prompts, then move to Dedicated for consistent throughput and data residency controls. Key asks surfaced on first calls: 'We cannot have any customer PII leave EU datacenters' (quote from CTO).

Recent activity/timeline (bullets from CRM):
- 2026-01-18: Initial inbound trial sign-up; captured as MQL, AE outreach.
- 2026-01-25: Demo w/ Jordan R.; high-level hosted API walkthrough + streaming demo. Customer: interested in chat & embeddings.
- 2026-02-04: Discovery call (Fireflies ff_2026-02-04_CloudScribe_intro). Discussed EU-only residency, SSO, SOC2. Asked for sample latency numbers from eu-west.
- 2026-02-18: Pricing intro email thread sent. Customer requests committed throughput pricing for Dedicated at 99k tokens/day baseline. (gmail thread-f:CA+2b8X_cloudscribe_pricing)
- 2026-03-02: POC kickoff call: scope defined for 4-week POC (hosted API first month, then pilot Dedicated in eu-west). Log of call ff_2026-03-02_poc-kickoff.
- 2026-03-06: Security questionnaire submitted (attached to Drive docs). Legal flagged data residency SLA and KMS integration details. Ticket created INF-8721.

POC details / acceptance criteria:
- Week 0-1: migrate 3 internal prompt templates to Hosted API; measure baseline token cost and response latency from eu-west-1 (avg target <120ms for 256-token chat prompt).
- Week 2: run Canary on Dedicated eu-west pool for 10% of traffic; measure 95th percentile latency and cost delta.
- Week 3-4: full workload pilot on Dedicated if SLOs met; validate KMS key provisioning and audit log ingestion to their SIEM.

Architecture & routing ask:
- Customer needs EU residency for both request/response and embeddings storage. Also wants multi-region routing fallback to another EU region (eu-west -> eu-central) if capacity constrained. Concern: cross-region routing increases latency; they want clear tradeoffs documented.
- Wants ability to route low-latency traffic to Dedicated eu-west while failing over to Hosted API eu-central variant with model fallback for emergency capacity.

Performance / cost constraints:
- Latency target: 95th percentile <200ms for short chat exchanges (<=128 tokens).
- Throughput target: baseline 50 RPS during business hours, burst to 500 at peak with autoscale.
- Cost sensitivity: prefer to keep monthly spend in 50k-150k ARR band; looking for recommendations on batching, KV caching, and quantized model variants to reduce per-token costs.

Security & compliance notes:
- Must pass SOC2 and provide SAML SSO for internal admins.
- KMS integration required for Dedicated; they asked how key rotation affects ongoing POC (we proposed a staging key).
- Retention controls: 90-day transient storage for request logs, with option to ship full audit to their SIEM.

Sales/contracting status:
- Pricing conversations ongoing. They asked for a 12-month committed Dedicated quote and a 3-month trial price for Hosted API usage during POC. SE to prepare cost delta analysis comparing Hosted vs Dedicated given their RPS profile.

Quotes / customer language captured:
- CTO: 'We need an inference partner who understands cost vs latency tradeoffs and gives us predictable bills.'
- Head of Product: 'If routing can be automated with safe fallbacks, we'll accept a small latency penalty in return for 99.9% availability.'

Next steps (short):
- SE (Maya) to deliver Dedicated eu-west cost estimate + whitepaper on multi-region routing latency tradeoffs by 2026-03-14.
- Legal/Customer to confirm minimal residency SLA language; AE to loop in Contracts.
- Start Hosted API pilot immediately after pricing agreement; then flip 10% traffic to Dedicated canary in week 2.

Open questions / blockers (CRM tags):
- Legal needs explicit SLA on where embeddings are stored and delete-on-request flow.
- Need to confirm cross-region KV cache behavior if fallback occurs.
- Payment & procurement: customer requires PO and 30-day net terms for initial committed seat.

CRM notes tone: fragmented, bullety, actionable. Good fit for onboarding to Mid-Market AE playbook.
